name: Postal
description: Full featured mail delivery platform for sending and receiving transactional and bulk email.

envVars.description: Public hostname for the Postal web UI
Password for the Postal MariaDB user

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      MAIN_DB_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-mariadb"
      MAIN_DB_PASSWORD: {{env.MARIADB_PASSWORD}}
      POSTAL_WEB_HOSTNAME: {{env.POSTAL_WEB_HOSTNAME}}
      RAILS_SECRET_KEY: {{env.RAILS_SECRET_KEY}}
      MARIADB_PASSWORD: {{env.MARIADB_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/config:/config
      - {{appDataPath}}/app:/opt/postal/app
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-mariadb
  {{serviceName}}-mariadb:
    image: mariadb:11
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-mariadb
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: postal
      MYSQL_USER: postal
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.MARIADB_PASSWORD}}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: {{env.MARIADB_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/mariadb:/var/lib/mysql
  {{serviceName}}-worker:
    image: ghcr.io/postalserver/postal:latest
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-worker
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: "postal worker"
